programme.desc: Exploring the world behind the scenes of a runway show helps in understanding its inspirations: Akris cultivates a taste for detail. Where does the expression "bon appétit!" come from? An immersive visit to the Souffle fair, a celebration of arts and crafts. The bubble skirt conquers the catwalk.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: Paul Bischof is a logger in Grande Béroche. After a whole life in the woods, he knows everything there is to know about trees. Before retiring, he shares his immense knowledge with a student in forestry and his apprentices.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: With generous silhouettes and delicate transparency, designer Arthur Avellano takes latex to its limits and beyond. Stéphanie Trolez brings the art of straw marquetry to cabinet-making.

programme.title: Chine, Les maitres de l’Art
programme.desc: Che Peng Fei sublimates traditional Chinese painting by charging it with a unique poetic sensibility. His art, inspired by nature and philosophy, evokes a rich, contemplative inner world.

programme.desc: Alexis and Antoine are going to make the most of a huge playing field: the Canadian tundra in the Yukon region. Whitehorse and its surroundings are covered by a vast network with more than 700 kms of biking trails.

programme.title: Psychic Witness

programme.title: Psychic Witness

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal
programme.desc: In St. Francisville, Louisiana lies the picturesque Myrtles Plantation. Situated 26 miles from Baton Rouge, it may not be the grandest of plantations, but what it lacks in presentation, it makes up for in disturbing history and lore. Owned by the Moss family, it’s touted as one of the most haunted places in America! Visitors have reported seeing apparitions, lights turning on and off, faces and handprints in mirrors, vanishing objects; hearing random footsteps, rattling doorknobs, children’s cries, and unexplained smells. The Myrtles Plantation has been featured on “Ghost Hunters,” “Ghost Adventures,” ”Unsolved Mysteries” and “Most Terrifying Places in America.”But is this plantation the paranormal hotspot it’s claimed to be? Does it hold the dark and tragic history of poisonings, hangings, mutilation, murder, and gunfire claimed? Can fact be separated from fiction? Ericka and her team are about to find out.

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal
programme.desc: After Dr. John Bell's unexpected suicide, owners of his home begin to experience strange noises, ghost sightings and discover creepy bloodstains on the floor. Second Sight Paranormal TV is called to investigate the haunted house and find out why Dr. Bell still lingers and what he wants. They soon discover he's not haunting alone.

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal
programme.desc: The historic red-light district of Pensacola was a place where you could find a good time. But in the modern era, you might just find something paranormal. Second Sight digs into the district’s many notably haunted spots of museums, restaurants, and theaters, seeking spirits that linger from a history of depravity and debauchery.

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal
programme.desc: Fort Morgan and Fort Blakeley once housed many soldiers and slaves. Those same souls may still reside within these aged structures built in times of war. Night descends as Second Sight seeks out the lost souls of war and peel back the dark history behind these historic locations.

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal
programme.desc: The DAR House of Mobile, Alabama has remained since 1860 as a historic location for weddings and dinner parties. But a part of the past remains as ghost activity occupies its walls. As Second Sight investigates, they discover that the spirits of children are present within the house. And they may want to play.

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal
programme.desc: The Swift-Coles House is one of the most beautiful sights of Bon Secour, Alabama but comes with a haunted history. The home was originally owned by Charles and Susan Swift who had many children. And their spirits may still haunt such a place as Second Sight soon discovers that not only will the spirits react but ask for the team by name.

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal

programme.desc: Fed up with her neglectful boyfriend Cory, Raina seizes a golden opportunity when he’s arrested by stealing his bail money and vanishes. Seeking refuge with her cousin Jessica, Raina’s survival instinct takes a dark turn as she is tempted by Jessica’s boyfriend, hoping to secure a new life. But when Cory unexpectedly busts out of jail and comes hunting for his cash, Raina must choose love or survival.

programme.title: Deeper
programme.desc: The story of Chasity, King, and Gotti is a tale of love, betrayal, and power. Gotti returns with a vengeance, seeking to reclaim his Dallas Kingpin status and Chasity's love. Despite their challenges, Chasity and King remain determined. As they plan their future, Gotti's secrets and power grab threaten their love. Will they triumph over his schemes or will he steal her heart? Follow their journey in the dangerous world of the hustle.

programme.title: Kiss Me Once
programme.desc: Gabrielle, a delusional romantic, fixates on anyone who shows her the slightest interest. Her obsession turns dangerous when her feelings aren't reciprocated.

programme.title: Vanity Flaw
programme.desc: Mallory is a young ambitious woman with dreams of becoming a successful dance choreographer in the industry. Being a risk taker, Mallory decides to dance at a strip club for one night after losing a dare, only to be captured by an obsessive man with a fetish for strippers and violence.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: Former Navy SEAL Ares Sterling, a family man with a dark past, lives peacefully until his wife Lisa is kidnapped after a home invasion. Desperate, Ares seeks help from his estranged father, King, a crime boss he blames for his tragic childhood. Ares revisits the shadows of his past, becoming ruthless to save Lisa and protect his daughter from similar loss, uncovering shocking secrets along the way.

programme.title: Single Saved and Searching
programme.desc: Leah puts all of her trust in God when it came to her relationships. For some reason her relationships still weren’t working out. After a big breakup with a long time boyfriend Leah sends out a prayer that would turn into an unexpected journey. God gives Leah a gift that makes men appear at her will, but Leah still questions why God gave her this gift.

programme.title: Till Death Do Us 2
programme.desc: The fates of Tamara, TJ, and even Marcus himself hang in the balance after the bloody kitchen shooting. Did anyone survive? Will Pastor Marcus's mysterious powers intervene? Meanwhile, Jessica, TJ's ex-wife, faces scrutiny for her past actions and the future of their children. With the threat of child protective services looming, the clock is ticking to find answers and rebuild shattered lives.

programme.title: Princess of the Trap House
programme.desc: When a local drug dealer is arrested and put in jail, he asks his daughter Diamond to run his operation. Diamond takes control of the empire, however it doesn’t sit well with members of the crew. Diamond gets word, from her trusted sources, that two members of the crew are plotting to overthrow her Father’s drug empire. Diamond must get rid of the two disloyal members of the crew before they take control of the operation.

programme.title: Don't Miss the Bus
programme.desc: Sierra, a single mother hustles in order to survive with long shifts and grunt work. Her faith is pinned on lottery tickets and men who exploit her vulnerability. When a stroke of luck has the ability to change her future forever, a missed bus stop could mean life or death.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Karmen, a successful businesswoman is secure and thriving in every part of her life, except for love. She downloads a dating app and seems to have found Mr. Right in Jermaine, but her best friends warn her that he might be a scammer. As Karmen falls deeper, she slowly falls victim to a network of lies and deceit, that could cost her life.

programme.title: Risk it All
programme.desc: Sierra, a gifted but overlooked painter, struggles to balance her artistic dreams with the reality of a stable life alongside her devoted but practical husband, Marcus. When a powerful and seductive art collector offers her the recognition she’s always craved, Sierra is drawn into a world where ambition blurs moral lines and desire turns dangerous. As passion, obsession, and betrayal collide, she must decide how much she’s truly willing to sacrifice to be seen.

programme.title: ToxiCity
programme.desc: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order. A night out leads him to Sierra, an alluring actress who quickly moves in. Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: Fatal Promises
programme.desc: Haunted by unresolved trauma, Renae Morgan swears off love until Kingston Coleman, a charming and powerful attorney, pulls her back in. When his lies and betrayal begin to surface, Renae turns to Eric, a loyal longtime friend, and together their search for truth spirals into obsession, revenge, and deadly consequences.

programme.title: For All Have Sinned
programme.desc: After the sudden death of his mother, Mano embarks on a violent path that stems from his grief and causes him to spiral. He lives by the mantra of Romans 3:23 “for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” When a local church members attempts to reach him, he finds a way to navigate his pain and grief.

programme.title: Death by Envy
programme.desc: An entire neighborhood is rattled when a man with a promising future is murdered in front of his wife.

programme.title: Body Count Bently
programme.desc: Bently has a past for being hardcore. After the murder of her father Jesse and the disappearance of "Kato," Bently hits the streets to find out who killed her father and to clear her name from all of the bodies that are being pinned on her.

programme.title: Cheddy Ace
programme.desc: After taking out a "hood loan" to invest in a janky business a year earlier, Cheddy Ace is faced with repaying the loan to a pair of thugs within 24 hours. Desperate to pay his debt, Cheddy and his nephews try everything to help him raise it.

programme.title: Cake
programme.desc: Young pastry chef, Ronnie, dreams of opening her own bakery, but friends, family, and her love life have plans of their own.

programme.title: Cake: A 2nd Slice
programme.desc: Ronnie finds herself in some deep, dark chocolate-like trouble when Heather falls in love with Carmen's unique brownie mix and Rick is in a troubling love triangle.

programme.title: Cake 3: Last Bite
programme.desc: Ronnie and Carmen have a disagreement that jeopardizes their friendship. Travis and Amanda have unfinished business that affects Marvin’s case, and Rick is tempted by someone from his past.

programme.title: Dangerous Affair
programme.desc: Erika and Ryan are a happily married couple living in a high rise Apartment in Atlanta, Ga. everything is going great until Erika meets a handsome, mysterious man in her building and they start having an affair. Once Ryan finds out about the affair Erika ends it. But the mystery man has other plans. Will the married couple survive the Dangerous Affair?

programme.title: Hail Mary
programme.desc: Mary went from having everything to losing it all within a blink of an eye. She taps into her inner hustle to help her get back on her feet. What starts off as a temporary hustle leads to a path of destruction.

programme.title: Legends of the Highway
programme.desc: Follow the true story of the Florida Highwaymen, 26 self-taught African American artists who forged their own path to success in the segregated 1950’s and 60’s. Their stories are guided by the mentorship of renowned landscape painters A.E. Backus, Alfred Hair, and Harold Newton. Their troupe captured Florida’s breathtaking landscapes and sold their paintings along state highways, circumventing the traditional art world that excluded them.

programme.title: A Mother's Adoration
programme.desc: Letricia is a single mother raising her son Jared after his father was killed 17 years earlier. When his uncle Jared comes back into his life, he seeks to cash in on Jared’s athletic talent. Letricia must fight to keep her son on the right path.

programme.title: Blood in the Comments
programme.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

programme.title: Maverick Movie

programme.title: Maverick Movie
programme.desc: After Simone fails to Kill Ried, Nivea launches a calculated plan to infiltrate Gotti’s inner circle.

programme.title: His Target
programme.desc: Keya meets Justin, an aspiring entrepreneur and thought she found the man of her dreams, but he saw her as an opportunity to make his ventures soar. The closer she gets to him, the more she falls in love, but his grip grows tighter and deadlier. A toxic relationship, soon grows into a power struggle with deadly consequences.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The World Pickleball League returns for an explosive Season 2 at the iconic Jio World Garden in BKC, Mumbai. The season opener features a high-stakes rematch of last year's final: the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans, owned by cinematic powerhouse Atlee and Priya Atlee, take on the formidable Pune United, led by owner Riteish Deshmukh. Witness world-class athletes from 18 countries compete in a series of intense Men’s Singles, Women’s Doubles, and Mixed Doubles matches. With the pressure of a "Davis Cup" atmosphere and the precision of tactical "kitchen" play, both teams battle for every point to establish early dominance in India’s premier pickleball league.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)

Both teams are competing for a coveted bid to the National Championship in Saint Louis, Missouri, which features a $30,000 prize pool.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: Experience a high-stakes "teeter-totter" battle as Utah State and Utah Tech 2 face off in the semifinals of the 2024 DUPR Nevada Super Regional. The atmosphere in Henderson is electric as Utah Tech’s young phenom, 15-year-old Mary Monson, showcases incredible shot sequencing and skill in the opening Women's Doubles match. After an intense start where each side fights for every inch of the court at Lifetime Fitness, the match reaches a fever pitch in the Mixed Doubles rounds. With a trip to the finals on the line, the rivalry culminates in a dramatic Dream Breaker, proving that in collegiate pickleball, no lead is safe until the final point is served.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). Only one fighter can come out on top and walk away as the new ‘King of Kickboxing’. Elsewhere, the always exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (72-6, 64 KO) goes up against ‘The Gladiator’ Cristian Ristea (44-27, 13 KO), Hamicha (42-2, 31 KO) puts his undefeated GLORY record on the line against late replacement Brice Kombou (20-6, 5 KO), and featherweights Andre Santos (23-2, 10 KO) and Deniz Demirkapu (15-5, 10 KO) will kick-off the main card.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (175-40-3, 27 KO) will rematch KO artist Abraham Vidales (18-4, 14 KO) and Portuguese sensation Miguel Trindade (64-8, 26 KO) will look to avenge his 2023 loss to the always entertaining Berjan Peposhi (32-6, 16 KO). Former GLORY title contender & leading Japanese fighter Kento Haraguchi (28-6-1, 18 KO) will go up against talented newcomer Hiroki Kasahara (39-8, 17 KO) while popular South Korean veteran Sung-hyun Lee (71-13-2, 17 KO) takes on top young prospect Yura Kono (17-1, 9 KO). In addition, the seven-fight card will be headlined by Shiro Matsumoto (55-17-4, 19 KO) defending his RISE bantamweight title against Koki Osaki (38-6-1, 21 KO). In the co-main event, budding superstar Ryujin Nasukawa (17-2, 8 KO) and heavy-hitter Kaito Hasegawa (17-2, 13 KO) battle for the vacant RISE super flyweight championship.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The welterweight superfight between former GLORY world champion Endy Semeleer (36-2, 18 KO) and current GLORY lightweight world champion Tyjani Beztati (26-4, 9 KO) will take center stage in the main event of the evening. After dominating the lightweight division, Beztati moves up to welterweight for the very first time in his GLORY career. GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (169-40-3, 27 KO) and RISE national champion Kento Haraguchi (25-3-1, 14 KO) made their trilogy fight official for the co-main event. Two former middleweight title challengers collide as the number one ranked Michael Boapeah (17-4-1, 7 KO) takes on the number three ranked Ulric Bokeme (32-5, 17 KO), both fighters chasing a rematch at champion Donovan Wisse. Top Dutch star Tayfun Özcan (86-10-3, 28 KO) will make his highly anticipated GLORY debut against French champion Majid Amarouche (25-2-1, 10 KO).

programme.desc: What a joy it is when elegance meets extraordinary performance! The Maserati Quattroporte, the Kelleners BMW GranCoupe and Porsche's 911 4S embody the perfect melange. We took a closer look at these prime examples of power combined with style.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Two weeks before the start of the famous 24 hours of Le Mans race, all teams are busy testing their cars on the traditional long distance track in France. Bad weather, accidents and a lot of tension, we documented the official test days in Le Mans 2013.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche 911 shows stylistic modesty like no other sports car in the world. It doesn't boast, avoids any loud appearance and puts form over function. We explored the history behind this iconic sports car and the reason why it has been so successful for more than 50 years. In addition: Porsche's Turbo S model, the traditional top model of the brand's 911 production series.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB11 - The first turbocharged Aston Martin
programme.desc: Aston Martin are pursuing future success with their DB11 model. Apart from the beautiful new design, turbochargers are used for the first time, but, not to worry, the magnificent V12 remains in place.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: The BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS and Porsche Cayenne Turbo are among the strongest and fastest SUVs in the world. Sports utility vehicles made in Germany are the embodiment of technical perfection, superior performance and unique comfort.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Luxury, lifestyle and exclusivity, no other cars transport these attributes better than the SUVs by Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo and Infinity. These stylish and excellently equipped SUVs embody a spirit of adventure and a zest for life.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: US SUVs and pickup trucks like the Cadillac Escalade, Chevrolet Tahoe, Ford Raptor or Dodge Ram are large, powerful and luxurious and exude the feeling of unlimited possibilities and adventure.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: The Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 has its origins in the Japanese army. Its shape won’t win any beauty contests or achieve the best results in the wind tunnel, but this is not really the point with an SUV like this.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Aston Martin Rapide S
programme.desc: Aston Martin is breaking new ground with the sport sedan – the „Rapide S“. Ever since the official car of James Bond became the Aston Martin, this brand has achieved cult status. Desirable, timelessly elegant, 2-door sports coupes are the DNA. But even the venerable British brand does not escape evolution - because with the Rapide S, Aston Martin goes new ways.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes rehearse a car crash scene for a movie, in which it should seem as if the main character of the movie really drives the car. The team achieves this directive by using digital effects and constructing a special airbag.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stunt coordinator Christoph looks back at the stunts of the last twelve shows and explains why a stunt sometimes works better in a test than on the film set. It's a summary of all the stunts of season 2, in addition to the best outtakes.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: After the shoot of the second season of this series, the stunt team created 13 little action movie sequences on their own that are sometimes funny, sometimes gritty, sometimes a bit mad, but always spectacular.

programme.title: Jeep Renegade
programme.desc: Jeep has been building SUVs since 1942. The Jeep Renegade comes from a traditional home. It is the youngest representative of the family and the most successful.

programme.title: Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10
programme.desc: The ice course on Lungauring, the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10 in winter training. Twelve participants in six Evos were taught the art of drifting with a four-wheel drive car. We accompanied a student on his first drifting experience.

programme.title: BMW F 800 R
programme.desc: BMW F 800 R is a robust roadster with a lot of spirit, and even motorcycle world champions count on its agility. World champion, Chris Pfeiffer is showing just how much fun you can have with a BMW F 800 R. His work motorcycle is based on the version that you can buy.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: We were allowed to drive a car of Citroen's sub-brand DS who try to set foot in the Formula E. In addition: Citroen and Peugeot share the same platform with their Rifter and Berlingo models. And: the facelift of the 508, Peugeot's flagship car.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Eager to overcome the damage to their image following the diesel scandal, Volkswagen allowed exclusive sneak peaks into future developments. We took their T-Cross on a covered drive. In addition: a first glance at Audi's A1 and A6 models.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: We compared the Ford Mustang 2.3 EcoBoost turbo to BMW's 430i with similar engine and drive specs. Also: Lada tries to take on Dacia with their Vesta SW station wagon. And: Opel's Grandland X may be an SUV, but it doesn't offer an all-wheel drive.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Is Kia's visually exciting Stinger able to convince in our test? In addition: we explored how Subaru's Boxer engine concept works in their XV model. And: Hyundai i30N vs. Volkswagen Golf GTI.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The history of Olaf Manthey, a racing legend who has won the 24-hour race four times in a row. Stick around to find out the secret of his success.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Christian Menzel asked our presenter Miriam to participate in a driver safety training where he showed tips and tricks on what to do in emergency situations.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Spring finally melted away the snow on the track and racing life returned to the Nürburgring. Drivers with gasoline in their veins started chasing their cars around the ring again.

programme.title: Historic Formula V
programme.desc: In the late fifties in America, the first Formula V racers were produced. The goal: Affordable motor sport for everyone. The small, open wheel cars were seen on the race tracks until the end of the 70s. Then the series was stopped. About 20 years ago a couple of Formula V owners came together and established the "Historic Formula V Europe" as an association.

programme.title: Bentley S2 Continental Flying Spur
programme.desc: Flowing lines and an elegance that is unmatched. The 1959 Bentley S2 Continental Flying Spur aims to build bridges in the company's model range. From the sporty origin of the brand to the luxury of its new owner, Rolls Royce.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Mustang celebrates its 50th anniversary at the Las Vegas Raceways and Marco takes part in this special event. He witnesses how tailor-made Shelby Cobras are manufactured and continues on his road trip through the US.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: How do conservative Californian petrolheads respond to a modern hybrid sports car like the BMW i8? On Marco's road trip through L.A. octane junkies who usually drive a Porsche 911, a Corvette or tuned bikes take the BMW to the test.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Kati from Munich is a big fan of US cars. She and her boyfriend fulfilled their dreams by buying a 1972 Chevy Chevelle that was found and imported directly from the USA by Frank Slopianka and his company Special Cars Berlin.

programme.title: Mercedes-AMG GT S Performmaster
programme.desc: Not far from Stuttgart is the home of the tuner Performmaster who specialize in the performance optimization of Mercedes-AMG models. They turned the already more-than-potent GT S sports car into a beast.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: In the US, SUVs aren't usually considered just workhorses but rather treated as everyday vehicles. Americans don't want to miss out on space, comfort and loading capacity. We show you the Chevrolet Suburban, Jeep Cherokee and GMC Yukon.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: SUVs usually are rather impressive right out of the factory, but there are many tuning and customizing options. In this episode we present Kelleners BMW X5, the Mercedes Brabus B63 and the Porsche Cayenne tuned by Techart.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: When the Audi A1 becomes the S1 and the Golf gets an R in its name, these small cars turn into all-wheel beasts. Also: the Mini Countryman gets a rejuvenation. And: a test drive with the best-selling Volvo XC60.

programme.title: Isle of Man - Tourist Trophy, Part 1
programme.desc: Tourist Trophy on the Isle of Man. The abbreviation "TT" could also stand for death and the devil. Every year the most dangerous motorcycle race in the world takes place. One lap in the Tourist Trophy is 61 kilometers long. 260 curves require everything from the riders. It's a unique myth.

programme.title: Isle of Man - Tourist Trophy, Part 2
programme.desc: The most dangerous motorcycle race in the world on the Isle of Man. Marshals at the TT are responsible for the highest possible levels of safety.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: German Engineering stands for quality, precision and, above all, impressive cars. Prime examples of this are the 135 million euro SLR and the AMG One. Also: the BMW M240i and the Mercedes-AMG GT 63 S E Performance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: These family station wagons provide a real adrenaline rush. The specialists at MTM catapult the Audi RS6 Avant with 1001 hp into the hypercar league. And the 408 hp AMG C43 is supposed to be more than just a family transporter. We put them to the test.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Extreme everyday cars. Using the Mercedes-AMG C 63 S E Performance and the Audi RS4/RS5 with Competition Package as examples, we show how two mid-range cars are transformed into sports cars ready for the racetrack.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Two GT models that provide surprising power and driving pleasure away from the usual brands. Petrol versus electric. Which Kia is more convincing? And: the Hyundai Kona N, a compact powerhouse.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: We highlight the history of the AMG S-Class from its beginnings to the present day and take a look at the most powerful vehicle in this model series to date, the Mercedes-AMG S 63 S E Performance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: 27 derivatives - the selection of Porsche 911s has never been so large. And never before have you been able to see all the models in one place - until now! We go speed dating with the Porsche 992 - which model will win the heart of the Bachelor?

programme.title: Petrolheads
programme.desc: This week on Petrol Heads, Sbu takes us inside the electrifying Gas Motor Show at Durban’s Suncoast Casino. From jaw-dropping custom builds and eye-catching exhibits to a parking lot transformed into a high-octane drift and stunt playground, the show is a feast for car lovers. We dive into the world of roaring engines, expert modifications, and the judging process behind standout rides. Plus, we explore the ins and outs of sound systems, suspension setups, and the reputable brands that drive South Africa’s car culture forward.

Based on the novel by Nelson Algren, The Man With the Golden Arm was added to the National Film Registry by the Library of Congress in 2020.
